result.title: Predicting Cognitive Profiles from Structural MRI using Spatial Graph Representation Learning
result.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. This work has been submitted to the Elsevier Array for possible publication
result.summary: Predicting cognitive abilities from structural neuroimaging remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and geometric complexity of brain morphology. Conventional models typically flatten regional morphometry into tabular features, failing to explicitly represent spatial relationships. We propose a Spatial-Topological Graph Neural Network (ST-GNN) to predict four distinct cognitive phenotypes across large pediatric cohorts (N = 2,378 to 2,424). By projecting regional morphometry onto a population-level standardized spatial graph, ST-GNN restricts message passing to defined neighboring regions. Evaluations demonstrate that ST-GNN effectively fuses spatial morphology with systemic covariates, outperforming linear baselines and topology-free deep models. Ablations reveal that imposing a sparse geometric topology (K-nearest neighbors) and utilizing global feature scaling - which preserves absolute morphometric scale - outperform fully connected networks and region-normalized approaches. These choices provide transferable architectural inductive biases, revealing differences between computational routing and morphometric feature attribution. Integrated Gradients analysis identified distinct morphological features consistent with neuroanatomical evidence, such as cerebellar volume for working memory and superior frontal surface area for executive function. These findings suggest standardized structural MRI provides useful information for task-specific cognitive prediction, establishing a foundation for MRI-based neurodevelopmental assessment.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ST-GNN，把区域形态学指标投射到群体标准化空间图上，将消息传递限制在空间邻域，用于预测儿童队列的四种认知表型；消融显示稀疏几何拓扑和保留绝对尺度的全局特征缩放优于全连接与区域归一化方案。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稀疏几何拓扑 vs 全连接」的路由消融，以及区分「计算路由」与「形态特征归因」的 Integrated Gradients 分析，可能为 LVR 中结构化潜在状态的空间先验设计、以及答案是否真正使用 latent 内容的因果诊断提供类比线索，可供核查。
